partnershipPlan: Two patient partners with migraine, one over 70, review the usable diary definition and the set-up leaflet.
socialListening: No social media listening; the clinic's patient feedback from 2026 is summarised.

items.theme: Filling it in on the bus
items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I fill in the paper diary on the way in, guessing most of the weeks.
items.implication: Use the prospective definition of a usable diary.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I have a phone that makes calls; if the paper goes, so does my diary.
items.implication: Keep paper and report usable diaries by age.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Without the diary I cannot sign off the injection, so we book another appointment in three months.
items.implication: Cost repeat appointments for deferred decisions.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: If better diaries mean more people qualify, that is good care, but we need to see it coming.
items.implication: Report the budget impact separately and early.

summary: Four composite voices on retrospective diaries, access, deferred decisions and the drug budget.
